evidence.name: Screen field: Round the section corners
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Round the section corners" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Round the section corners
sections.description: Rounds all four corners of the section. The default 0 keeps them sharp and square; higher values (try 8 to 16) give a soft card look that pairs well with a solid background or border to make the section stand out as its own block. The range is 0 to 50 pixels.
